events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $5.00 (model confidence 0.95)
events.body:
NS-0 routes this case: the driver cancelled and the app reason was rider_no_show, so NS-1 / NS-2 govern [F3].

NS-1(i) fails: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:01:00 while 599 m from the pickup point, and his closest approach over the whole trip was 599 m — he never came within 200 m [F6][F1][NS-1]. The system record of the GPS track overrides the driver's written statement that he "waited more than 5 minutes at the pickup" [F14][F1][F2].

NS-1(ii) fails as well: continuous time at the pickup counted from arrival is 0 s, and the 5-minute free wait (300 s) was not met; the driver cancelled 3 min 30 s after his tap and only 6 min 30 s after acceptance [F6][F5][F3][NS-1].

NS-1(iii) passes — 2 in-app messages (first 13:01:25, "I'm here already … please come out") and 1 in-app call (13:02:30, not answered) — but one failed condition is enough [F4][F9][F13][NS-1]. The rider's reply "I'm at the pickup point, no car here. Where are you?" confirms the rider was waiting at the pickup point, which the GPS agrees with, not the driver's location [F10][F1].

Because a condition of NS-1 fails, the fee must be voided and refunded in full: amount = the cancellation fee on record, $5.00 [F3][F7][NS-2]. The driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point, which is a fake arrival confirmation and requires flag_account under NS-2 [F6][F1][NS-2].

The rider's complaint and the chat read as a factual dispute about whether the driver was at the pickup point; nothing in the complaint, the chats or the driver's statement describes a threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous driving [F9][F10][F11][F14][SAFE-1]. The record is complete: GPS track continuous, all three messages timestamped, call log present, cancellation reason and fee on record, so no outcome-relevant record is missing [F1][F2][F3][F4][F12][F13][TH-4].
